note:
⛔ SNG-466. THE SENSE ROUND AND BONUS-ACTION BUILDUP. Erik: 'I don't know how it will work to concede the momentum that round. I think it would be better to make sure it's TAGGED WITH READ at r1 so it can be used in the SENSE ROUND of a fight then used AGAIN in the action round. We do have a system in place that earns bonus actions in combat, so perhaps we should think through a more elaborate BONUS ACTION BUILDUP SYSTEM.'
⚠️ BUILT ON `charges.json` RATHER THAN BESIDE IT — that file already defines `rate` (every pass banks something) and `gate` (a pass banks its full value or nothing). ⛔ TEMPO IS A CHARGE THAT BANKS IN COMBAT AND SPENDS AS AN ACTION.

theSenseRound.what: ⛔ A ROUND HAS TWO SLOTS: a SENSE slot and an ACTION slot. Most crafts use the action slot. A craft tagged `read` uses the SENSE slot instead — ⚠️ WHICH MEANS IT DOES NOT COST YOU YOUR ACTION, and the same craft can be used again in the action slot the same round.
theSenseRound.why: ⚠️ My first draft had the reader FORFEIT the round's momentum. ⛔ ERIK IS RIGHT THAT THIS IS BOTH HARD TO WIRE AND WRONG IN FEEL: a fighter who reads their opponent is not standing still, they are fighting and watching. The sense slot says that plainly.
theSenseRound.rule: ⛔ A CRAFT MAY OCCUPY THE SENSE SLOT ONLY IF IT CARRIES THE `read` TAG. One sense action per round.

readTag.grants: resolves in the sense slot; does not consume the action slot
readTag.note: ⚠️ The `read` tag is NOT the same as the `reveal` FUNCTION. Reveal says what the craft produces; read says WHEN IT RESOLVES.

theSenseRound.contested:
⛔ SNG-468, ERIK: 'Dirty fighting — throwing sand or dirt into the face of an opponent during the sense step could be a way the March or other physical traditions work. Umbrals could drop a globe of shadow on the person's head, etc by tradition flavour. So you can choose to attempt to SENSE (normal success buildup chance) or to OBSCURE (certain skills and abilities are designed to beat a sense) — and the opponent can choose to sense or obscure as well.'
⛔ SO THE SENSE SLOT IS A CONTEST, NOT A FREE ACTION. Each side declares SENSE or OBSCURE before the action slot resolves.
⚠️ THIS IS BETTER THAN WHAT I AUTHORED. A free sense slot is value with no decision in it; a contested one is a real choice every round, and it gives the physical traditions something to do in a slot I had quietly reserved for the clever ones.

theChoice.SENSE: ⛔ Read the opponent. On success, bank tempo and take the edge your craft grants. This is the default and the buildup path.
theChoice.OBSCURE: ⛔ Deny their read. On success, their sense action fails and they bank nothing — and some obscure crafts carry a penalty into their action slot as well.
theChoice.resolution: ⚠️ SENSE vs SENSE — both read, both bank, nobody is denied. SENSE vs OBSCURE — contested roll; the obscurer is the aggressor and wins ties, because throwing dirt is easier than reading a man with dirt in his eyes. OBSCURE vs OBSCURE — both waste the slot, and that is funny once.
theChoice._designNote: ⛔ OBSCURE BEATS SENSE ON A TIE. That single rule is what stops the sense slot from belonging permanently to the perceptive traditions.

obscureByTradition.Breaking (marcher): ⛔ DIRT IN THE EYES. Sand, gravel, a cloak snapped across the face, a kicked brazier. Erik's example, and it is the model: crude, instant, and it beats a better fighter's read.
obscureByTradition.Dark (umbral): ⛔ A GLOBE OF SHADOW dropped over their head — they are not blinded so much as given nothing to look at.
obscureByTradition.Dark (veilwright): ⚠️ A FALSE TELL. You show them something to read, and they read it, and it is wrong.
obscureByTradition.Chaos (churnfolk): Nothing to read, because you have not decided yet either.
obscureByTradition.Body (somatic): A stance that reads as three different attacks and resolves as a fourth.
obscureByTradition.Light (blazeborn): ⚠️ GLARE — the opposite move, denying sight with too much rather than too little.
obscureByTradition.Order (lattice): A pattern so regular it carries no information.
obscureByTradition.Death (ashwarden): ⛔ THEY LOOK AT YOU AND SEE HOW THEY END. Nothing tactical survives that.
obscureByTradition._note: ⚠️ EVERY TRADITION SHOULD REACH ONE OBSCURE CRAFT. This is the second slot in the round and no tradition should be locked out of it.

tempo.what: ⛔ TEMPO IS A BANKED CHARGE. It accrues during a contest and spends as an extra action slot.

accrual._movedOffSense: ⛔ SENSE NO LONGER BANKS TEMPO. The read already pays — Deduced Strike's mark, Attunement's information, Memory-Palace's bonus. ⚠️ BANKING ON TOP OF THAT DOUBLE-PAYS THE SAME ACTION and turns a consequence-free step into the strongest economic move in the round.
accrual._note: ⚠️ Tempo now banks entirely off the ACTION slot and the momentum meter. Reading remains free and remains consequence-free.

spend.2 tempo: an action that would normally take the whole round — a full crafting, a long shot, a considered strike
spend.3 tempo: ⛔ ACT BEFORE THE ROUND OPENS, ahead of everyone, once

tempo.cap: ⚠️ THREE. Tempo does not bank across a contest — it is momentum, not savings, and it empties when the fight ends.
tempo._whyItIsGood:
⛔ IT REWARDS COMMITTING WELL, NOT OBSERVING. A Marcher wins rounds and banks; a Figurist who prepared the ground banks; a careful fighter conserving banks slowly; ⚠️ AND SURGE BANKS NOTHING, so the greedy line and the patient line stay genuinely different.
⛔ AND READING STAYS FREE — which is what CCode's warning protects: the sense step is where you learn, not where you win.

wiring: add a `senseSlot` to the round alongside the action slot
the sense slot is CONTESTED: each side declares SENSE or OBSCURE; obscure wins ties
a craft with `read: true` resolves in the sense slot and does not consume the action
tempo accrues per the rate table above and caps at 3
tempo spends per the spend table; spending is declared before the round's rolls
forCCode.smallest: ⛔ THE MINIMUM VIABLE VERSION IS THE `read` TAG AND THE SENSE SLOT. Tempo can follow; the sense slot alone makes Deduced Strike work as authored.

alreadyShipped: the sense slot not consuming the action
the read contested against a concealing craft (CCODE-51, senseResistOf)
actuallyNew: obscure as a DECLARED choice rather than passive resistance
⛔ THE TIE RULE — the obscurer wins ties
the tempo bank (now banking off the action slot only)

_correction_20260816:
⛔ CCODE, 2026-08-16, AND HE IS RIGHT: 'The sense step DELIBERATELY DOES NOT MOVE MOMENTUM — it was built consequence-free so that READING ISN'T A WAY TO WIN. Tempo banking off it reverses that, and it is the kind of decision that should be reversed ON PURPOSE rather than arrive as a side effect of a new currency.'
⚠️ MY TABLE HAD 'a read that produced usable information: 1.0' AS THE TOP ACCRUAL — the single largest source, sitting directly on the step that was built to be consequence-free. ⛔ I WOULD HAVE OVERTURNED A DELIBERATE DESIGN DECISION AS A SIDE EFFECT OF A NEW CURRENCY.
⛔ ALSO CORRECTED: §4.1's headline — 'a sense craft resolves in its own slot and does not consume the action' — IS ALREADY SHIPPED BEHAVIOUR. CCODE-45 established 'a TURN is sense → action → bonus' and `sbFreshTurn()` holds three selections; CCODE-51 already contests the read via `senseResistOf`, and `phaseDenied(…, 'sense')` already exists as obscure-as-an-effect. ⚠️ I WROTE A SPEC SECTION FOR SOMETHING THAT EXISTS. Same class as counting my own hand-applied `sense` tag and concluding the corpus had three sense crafts when it had fifty-six.
⛔ WHAT IS ACTUALLY NEW IS THREE SMALL THINGS: obscure as a DECLARED choice rather than a passive resistance, the tie rule, and the tempo bank.
